scope: Delegation names the principles that apply in a brief (owner ruling of 2026-11-05, after a search of past sessions). No report and no upstream trait rows: a change of our own.

subject: ours:delegation
why: Owner ruling of 2026-11-05. A search of past sessions found the router's principle lines rarely led to a read, even where a principle's situation held, and most work here runs in delegates on tight briefs. So a brief names the path of each principle whose situation holds, and a reviewer or critic gets those the change falls under.
